verdicts.reason: The two layouts are nearly identical and share the same flaws. The NEW FLAVOR badge is shrunk until it can't be read and sits stranded inside the left circle. The logo is tiny and pushed into the bottom-left corner. The subtitle is squeezed into a narrow five-line column, and the headline sits on top of the decorative circle on the right. A breaks the headline better ('Chase / the Light'), keeping the gold phrase together. B's 'Chase the / Light' splits the gold phrase across two lines, which looks awkward and leaves 'Light' stranded on its own line.
